operationalMode.title: Operational mode
operationalMode.description: Operational mode of the fan coil

displayedFanSpeed.title: Displayed fan speed
displayedFanSpeed.description: 0 = auto, 1-6 = speed 1-6 for ECM fans; for 3-speed fans 2 = low, 4 = medium, 6 = high

actualFanSpeed.title: Actual fan speed
actualFanSpeed.description: 1-6 = speed 1-6 for ECM fans; for 3-speed fans 2 = low, 4 = medium, 6 = high; 7 = fan off

valveOpen.title: Valve open
valveOpen.description: Equals true if the valve is open

deviceOn.title: Device on
deviceOn.description: Equals true if the device is on
